---
applyTo: "src/**/*.ts"
name: Code Review Instructions
description: Instructions for reviewing TypeScript code in BetterYTM.
---

# Code Review Scope

- Focus mostly on TypeScript source files under `src/` and assets like stylesheets and JSON resource files under `assets/`.
- Ignore anything under `docs/typedocs/` — those are autogenerated and should not be reviewed or modified.

# Review Priorities

- Flag violations of the rules in the general project instructions (coding style, ESLint, tsconfig).
- Highlight any security issues (OWASP Top 10: XSS, injection, SSRF, broken access control, etc.), especially around DOM manipulation and user-facing HTML/CSS.
- Point out incorrect or missing TypeScript types; prefer strict types over `any`.
- Call out unnecessary verbosity or over-engineering (needless abstractions, redundant comments, dead code).
- Note deviations from the vanilla DOM API patterns used throughout the codebase (no framework idioms).
- Flag incorrect or missing use of UserUtils (`DataStore`, `GMStorageEngine`, `DataStoreSerializer`) and CoreUtils (`NanoEmitter`) where those would be the idiomatic choice.
- Identify race conditions or incorrect observer/event-listener lifecycle management.

# Review Style

- Be concise and direct. Group related issues together.
- Suggest concrete fixes, not just descriptions of problems.
- Do not flag style nits that the linter already enforces.
- Do not suggest adding comments unless the logic is genuinely non-obvious.
